ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a regional outline map; the main outline resembles Madagascar Island; the map is marked with the 47°E meridian and an approximately 20° latitude line; places A and B are located on the island or near it. Then reason: the question stem states that places A and B have synchronized sunrise times every New Year's Day, so "at this time" corresponds to around New Year's Day, that is, around January 1. January is winter in the Northern Hemisphere, and in winter the North Indian Ocean is affected by the northeast monsoon, and the surface monsoon current generally flows from east to west. Therefore the seawater in the North Indian Ocean sea area flows westward.
